about: R27 review ledger (D110). One entry per safety-class Spanish string: the exact English, the exact Spanish, sha = sha256(en + U+0000 + es), and how far its review has got — draft (written), reviewed (blind second pass agreed AND back-translated to English without the original), person (a Spanish-reading crew member read it on a phone, R27 #5 / R29 #3). Safety-class Spanish is served only at reviewed or person. Editing either side without re-reviewing fails the build (src/i18n/ledger.ts ledgerProblems).
